summary.description: One short paragraph: what happened and the change that caused it — or that no change was located.

checklist.description: One entry per check id in dossier/checklist.md — your own call on each measurement.

check.description: The check id, exactly as it appears in dossier/checklist.md.

assessment.description: ruled_out: measured and does not explain any of the movement. contributing: part of the story. explains: accounts for the movement on its own. unknown: the evidence does not settle it.

detail.description: Why you assessed it that way, citing what you checked.

hypotheses.description: 1-4 root-cause hypotheses, most likely first. Empty is a legitimate answer when you located no change and nothing survives as a lead.

evidence_trace_ids.description: Trace ids from this finding's own evidence refs (either side) that evidence this. A traffic_shift or behavior_change hypothesis set must include at least one baseline-side id — that verdict compares the baseline against the flagged evidence, and an uncited comparison is downgraded.

detailed_report.description: The full investigation as markdown: what was checked, in code and in traces, and how the evidence supports the verdict. Must end with an '## Evidence audit' section — a table mapping every load-bearing claim to its evidence (a trace id, a repo path/commit, or a query) — and a '## What would settle it' section naming the next experiment.
